recipes.name: Run 1
dims: Wedge (1/8 of a log), from a 12 in log
Length along the corner between the ripped face and the slanted sawn face
Length along the bark corner of the ripped face
Length along the bark corner of the slanted sawn face

steps.title: Take the stock
steps.text: Take a wedge (1/8 of a log) stick at least 85.06 in long. Write 1 on it in chalk. It is longer than a 72 in stick: splice two, or cut it from a longer log.

steps.title: Cut 1 (first end) on the mitre saw
steps.text: Lay the stick on the ripped face on the saw table, with the bark corner of the slanted sawn face against the fence, the keeper to the LEFT of the blade. Mitre 34.4° — followed from the fence toward you, the cut drifts to the RIGHT. Bevel 11.2° — top of the blade tilted to the LEFT. Slide it so the blade just clears the raw end everywhere -- about 0.5 in in from the end at its longest. The offcut, right of the blade, is a tapered piece: 3.31 in along the bark corner of the slanted sawn face, down to 0.50 in along the corner between the ripped face and the slanted sawn face. This cut meets the panel's edge (bevelled to the seam).

steps.title: Cut 2 (second end) on the mitre saw
steps.text: Lay the stick on the ripped face on the saw table, with the corner between the ripped face and the slanted sawn face against the fence, the keeper to the LEFT of the blade. Mitre 34.4° — followed from the fence toward you, the cut drifts to the LEFT. Bevel 11.2° — top of the blade tilted to the LEFT. Measure from the first cut and mark: 82.27 in along the point; 84.31 in along the corner between the ripped face and the slanted sawn face; 79.11 in along the bark corner of the ripped face; 78.68 in along the bark corner of the slanted sawn face. Join the marks across the ripped face -- the blade follows that line. The offcut, right of the blade, is only a sliver. This cut meets the panel's edge (bevelled to the seam).

steps.title: Check it
steps.text: Finished: 84.31 in along the corner between the ripped face and the slanted sawn face, 82.27 in along the point, 79.11 in along the bark corner of the ripped face, 78.68 in along the bark corner of the slanted sawn face. Measure each against the list before it goes in.

steps.title: Put it in
steps.text: It goes in as run 1: on a sawn face against the flat side, point back toward the wall.
